item.summary: fix(agents): deliver token-limited partial replies instead of discarding them (#123546) * fix(agents): deliver token-limited partial replies instead of discarding them `isIncompleteTerminalAssistantTurn` accepted `hasAssistantVisibleText` but the `length` branch never read it, so a turn that stopped at the output token limit after emitting visible text was classified incomplete. The whole reply was then replaced with "Agent couldn't generate a response" and the run was marked abandoned. Respect the flag: a `length` stop is incomplete only when there is no visible text and no terminal tool output. A length stop that did produce text now delivers that text with a truncation notice appended, so a cut-off answer is not mistaken for a complete one. * fix(agents): scope the truncation notice and align trajectory status Review follow-up on the token-limited partial reply fix. The truncation notice keyed only on stopReason, so a length stop that also produced terminal output (tool media, a committed source reply) gained an extra text reply telling the user to ask for a continuation.
